learning_objectives: Understand and use two-way vowel harmony.
scope_included: choose e or a in transparent practice forms, using -lAr only as a declared carrier for suffix choice
scope_excluded: four-way harmony, lexical exceptions and full plural use

references.title: Türk Dil Kurumu: Sesler ve Ses Uyumları
Türkiye Maarif Vakfı: Türkçenin Yabancı Dil Olarak Öğretimi Programı

skills.description_en: Recognise whether a familiar vowel-harmony practice form uses a or e in its ending.
Find the last vowel of an A1 noun and classify it as back or front.
Choose -lar or -ler for a transparent noun ending based on its final stem vowel.
Write a complete correctly spelt noun + -lar/-ler practice form.

lesson.short_explanation_en: In Turkish, a two-way vowel-harmony ending uses either a or e. Find the final vowel of the word: after a, ı, o or u (back vowels), the ending uses a; after e, i, ö or ü (front vowels), it uses e. Here -lar/-ler is simply a visible pattern for practising that choice: kitaplar but defterler. The full meaning and use of plural forms is taught in a later topic.

rule_blocks.heading_en: Use the last vowel to choose a or e
rule_blocks.explanation_en: Turkish has a back group (a, ı, o, u) and a front group (e, i, ö, ü). In a two-way vowel-harmony ending, a back last vowel selects a and a front last vowel selects e. Look at the last vowel of the stem, not just the first vowel.
rule_blocks.pattern: last vowel a / ı / o / u → -lAr = -lar | last vowel e / i / ö / ü → -lAr = -ler
usage_notes_en: -lAr is a label for this vowel-choice practice; it is not a learner-facing word.
For a longer word, locate its final vowel before choosing the ending.
These examples use regular, transparent words; lexical exceptions are not covered.
common_errors_en: şehirlar is wrong: the final vowel of şehir is i, so write şehirler.
okuller is wrong: the last vowel in okul is u, so write okullar.

rule_blocks.heading_en: Attach the ending directly to the word
rule_blocks.explanation_en: For this exercise, -lar/-ler provides a simple visible carrier for the a/e decision. The completed word is written without a space. This lesson tests the spelling choice; the wider uses of plural nouns come later.
usage_notes_en: Do not use a four-way ı/i/u/ü choice here.
Meaning and usage of plurality, including expressions with numbers, are outside this micro-lesson.
common_errors_en: elma ler is wrong because the ending is both detached and the wrong vowel choice.
biberlar is wrong because the last vowel is e, which selects -ler.

form_tables.title_en: Two-way choice from the last vowel

contexts.setting_en: Ayşe and Mehmet are checking spelling cards during a beginner Turkish lesson; the words are read aloud as labels.
A learner writes a short shopping list and marks the vowel used in each ending.

lines.speaker: Zeynep
lines.target: Elmalar: a. Biberler: e. Üzümler: e.
lines.translation_en: The endings are a in “elmalar”, e in “biberler” and e in “üzümler”.

examples.note_en: The last vowel of kitap is a, so the practice ending is -lar.
The last vowel is e, so the ending is -ler.
Dotless ı is a back vowel, so the ending uses a.
The last vowel is i; this front vowel takes the e-ending.
The last vowel is o, a back vowel, so the ending uses a.
Ö is a front vowel; the ending uses e.
The last vowel is u, a back vowel; the ending uses a.
The final ü is a front vowel, so the ending uses e.
The final a is back, so choose -lar.
The final e is front, so choose -ler.

exercises.instruction_en: Choose the correct form.
exercises.prompt_en: Which vowel appears in the added ending of kitaplar?

options.explanation_en: a is the vowel in -lar after the back vowel of kitap.
e would be used after a front vowel.
ı is not a choice in this two-way pattern.
i is not a choice in this two-way pattern.

hint_steps: Look at the vowel at the end, not at the beginning of the word.
The final part is lar.
exercises.feedback_correct_en: Correct. The final stem vowel determines a or e in this practice ending.
exercises.feedback_wrong_en: The ending in kitaplar contains a, not e.
exercises.explanation_en: The last vowel in kitap is a, so the added ending uses a.

exercises.instruction_en: Choose the correct form.
exercises.prompt_en: Which vowel appears in the added ending of defterler?

options.explanation_en: a would match a back last vowel.
e is selected after the final front vowel in defter.
ı belongs to the four-way pattern, not here.
ü belongs to the four-way pattern, not here.

hint_steps: Find the letters after defter.
The ending is ler.
exercises.feedback_correct_en: Correct. The final stem vowel determines a or e in this practice ending.
exercises.feedback_wrong_en: The suffix vowel in defterler is e.
exercises.explanation_en: defter ends in the front vowel e; its ending is -ler.

exercises.instruction_en: Choose the correct form.
exercises.prompt_en: Which noun has a back final vowel?

options.explanation_en: The last vowel of şehir is i, which is front.
The last vowel of köprü is ü, which is front.
The last vowel of kız is dotless ı, which is back.
The only vowel in göz is ö, which is front.

hint_steps: First find the vowel nearest the end of each word.
Remember that dotless ı is a back vowel.
exercises.feedback_correct_en: Correct. The final stem vowel determines a or e in this practice ending.
exercises.feedback_wrong_en: Only kız has a back final vowel among these four words.
exercises.explanation_en: kız has ı, while şehir, göz and köprü end in front vowels.

exercises.instruction_en: Choose the correct form.
exercises.prompt_en: Which word uses the front-vowel form of the practice ending?

options.explanation_en: The last vowel in kitap is a, so the ending uses -lar.
The last vowel in okul is u, so the ending uses -lar.
The last vowel in kız is ı, so the ending uses -lar.
defter ends with front vowel e and takes -ler.

hint_steps: Compare the ending vowels in the four words.
Look for a word ending in ler.
exercises.feedback_correct_en: Correct. The final stem vowel determines a or e in this practice ending.
exercises.feedback_wrong_en: defterler is the only form here with the front-vowel ending -ler.
exercises.explanation_en: defter ends in front vowel e, so it takes -ler.

exercises.feedback_wrong_en: The last vowel of kitap is back, so choose a, not e.

exercises.prompt_en: Type only the missing letter in the ending for defter.

exercises.feedback_correct_en: Correct. The final stem vowel determines a or e in this practice ending.
exercises.feedback_wrong_en: The last vowel of defter is front, so select e.

exercises.feedback_correct_en: Correct. The final stem vowel determines a or e in this practice ending.
exercises.feedback_wrong_en: Write gözler, not gözlar: ö requires -ler.

exercises.instruction_en: Type the correct form or missing vowel as instructed.
exercises.prompt_en: Write the whole practice form for okul with the correct -lar/-ler ending.
hint_steps: Look at the last vowel, not the first.
The final u is a back vowel.
exercises.feedback_correct_en: Correct. The final stem vowel determines a or e in this practice ending.
exercises.feedback_wrong_en: Write okullar, not okuller: the last vowel u requires -lar.

exercises.instruction_en: Type the correct form or missing vowel as instructed.
exercises.prompt_en: Write the whole practice form for köprü with the correct -lar/-ler ending.
hint_steps: The final vowel has two dots.

exercises.feedback_correct_en: Correct. The final stem vowel determines a or e in this practice ending.
exercises.feedback_wrong_en: Write köprüler, not köprülar: ü requires -ler.

exercises.instruction_en: Type the correct form or missing vowel as instructed.
exercises.prompt_en: On a shopping word card, write the whole practice form for elma.

It ends in back vowel a.
exercises.feedback_correct_en: Correct. The final stem vowel determines a or e in this practice ending.
exercises.feedback_wrong_en: elmalar uses a in the ending, not e.

exercises.instruction_en: Choose the correct form.
exercises.prompt_en: Choose the correctly written practice form for biber.

options.explanation_en: The last vowel e takes -ler.
The last vowel is front e, so -lar does not fit.

hint_steps: Look at the vowel in the last syllable of biber.
It is e, a front vowel.
exercises.feedback_correct_en: Correct. The final stem vowel determines a or e in this practice ending.
exercises.feedback_wrong_en: Choose biberler; biberlar has the wrong vowel harmony.

exercises.feedback_wrong_en: The correct form is üzümler, not üzümlar.

options.explanation_en: The final e is front, so use -ler.

The last vowel is e.
exercises.feedback_correct_en: Correct. The final stem vowel determines a or e in this practice ending.
exercises.feedback_wrong_en: Write anneler; annelar is the wrong vowel choice.

vocabulary_audit.note: All vocabulary annotations use reviewed A1 dictionary headwords. Attached -lar/-ler endings are grammar rather than vocabulary lemmas. Single vowel options are letters, not lexical terms.

level_audit.note: The prior vowel/casing topic supplies the prerequisite. This lesson uses written -lar/-ler forms solely to test a/e selection; plural usage, four-way vowel harmony and exceptions are not taught.
